card.name: First drug in an interaction pair
card.fires_on: The first-named drug (often partway through its name) or a nearby word in drug-interaction sentences, where an 'and' or 'with' plus a second drug is expected next. It also appears after words like 'effect of' or 'coadministration of'.

modes.label: Partway through first drug name
modes.description: Inside the name of the first drug in a pair, such as methadone, itraconazole, warfarin, cyclosporine or ritonavir.

modes.label: Interaction table or list cues
modes.description: Words or marks in interaction tables and lists where a drug or drug class is being tied to another.
